_comment: PROTECTED — the trading agent may not edit this file or anything in core/. Changes here are made by the human operator only (commit prefix 'operator:').
_venue_comment: Sports agent trades Polymarket US only (gateway.polymarket.us). Paper only.
_sim_bankroll_comment: Paper bankroll PER LANE. Each of the 8 lanes starts with this amount and is scored separately.

screener._comment: Tunables for the screening tier (core/screen.py). Haiku subagents screen batches; cost is counted in batches.

lanes._comment: Hard limits for the per-lane, per-league thresholds in strategy/params/<lane>.json. core/params.py is the only tool that changes those files and enforces these rules; core/validate.py re-checks them in CI.

tier_unlock._comment: A league may bet tier 2 or 3 markets only after that league+tier has this many settled forecasts with forecast brier_delta strictly below max_brier_delta (agent better than the market mid).

dial_in._comment: A lane may be promoted from paper to dialed when all hold.
